{{Quote|Here's a slider for those who like things neat 'n tidy. We serve this one up with a single patty and a precisely measured amount of strider cheese sauce--nothing more, nothing less. It's perfection every time! |Dex's Diner menu, on the Khomm slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Strider cheese''' was a type of [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]] used to make [[strider cheese sauce]]. The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used the [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] to make the  [[Khomm slider]]s that he sold at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[slider]] was created by Jettster with inspiration from<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> the planet<ref name="Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]]. The cheese shared its name<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> with the [[Khommite strider/Legends|Khommite strider]], an [[Species/Legends|animal]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Khomm.<ref name="Guide to Planets and Moons" />

==Behind the scenes==
Strider cheese was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
